```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(BPCells)
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(future)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

plan(multisession, workers = 16)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 8 * 1024^3)
```

```{r load}
obj <- readRDS("../fig1/results/obj.fig1.rds")
```

```{r subset_tcells}
t.cells <- subset(obj, celltype == "T_Cells")

umap_df <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(t.cells, "umap"))

keep <- rownames(umap_df)[
  abs(umap_df$UMAP_1 - mean(umap_df$UMAP_1)) < 3 * sd(umap_df$UMAP_1) &
  abs(umap_df$UMAP_2 - mean(umap_df$UMAP_2)) < 3 * sd(umap_df$UMAP_2)
]

cat("T cells before filtering:", ncol(t.cells), "\n")
t.cells <- t.cells[, keep]
cat("T cells after filtering: ", ncol(t.cells), "\n")
```

```{r}
DimPlot(t.cells, group.by = "cloneSize", label = F, pt.size = 1, alpha = 1, raster = T, raster.dpi = c(2048, 2048)) +
  NoLegend() + ggtitle(NULL)
ggsave("figs/umap.t.cells.cloneSize.pdf", height = 5, width = 5, dpi = 600)

DimPlot(t.cells, group.by = "cloneSize", label = F, pt.size = 1, alpha = 1, raster = T, raster.dpi = c(1024, 1024)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.title = element_blank(), plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.position = "none", aspect.ratio = 1)
ggsave("figs/umap.t.cells.cloneSize.png", height = 8, width = 8, dpi = 600, bg = "transparent")
```

```{r clonesize_proportions}
table(t.cells$cloneSize)
clone_levels <- c("Hyperexpanded (0.1 < X <= 1)", "Large (0.01 < X <= 0.1)",
                  "Medium (0.001 < X <= 0.01)", "Small (1e-04 < X <= 0.001)",
                  "Rare (0 < X <= 1e-04)", "Missing")

clone_colors <- c(
  "Hyperexpanded (0.1 < X <= 1)" = "#F8766D",
  "Large (0.01 < X <= 0.1)"      = "#A3A500",
  "Medium (0.001 < X <= 0.01)"   = "#00BF7D",
  "Small (1e-04 < X <= 0.001)"   = "#00B0F6",
  "Rare (0 < X <= 1e-04)"        = "#E76BF3",
  "Missing"                      = "#999999"
)

clone_df <- t.cells@meta.data %>%
  mutate(cloneSize = ifelse(is.na(cloneSize), "Missing", as.character(cloneSize)),
         cloneSize = factor(cloneSize, levels = clone_levels)) %>%
  group_by(orig.merge, cloneSize) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(orig.merge, cloneSize, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  group_by(orig.merge) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

sample_order <- clone_df %>%
  select(orig.merge, cloneSize, prop) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cloneSize, values_from = prop, values_fill = 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(Missing == 1), `Hyperexpanded (0.1 < X <= 1)`) %>%
  pull(orig.merge)

clone_df <- clone_df %>%
  mutate(orig.merge = factor(orig.merge, levels = sample_order))

ggplot(clone_df, aes(x = orig.merge, y = prop, fill = cloneSize)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, color = "white", linewidth = 0.15,
           position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = clone_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.position = "none")
ggsave("figs/barplot.clonesize.proportions.pdf", height = 4, width = 15, dpi = 600)
```



```{r}
s10 <- subset(t.cells, orig.ident == "S10")
table(s10$orig.ident)

s10 <- FindVariableFeatures(s10, nfeatures = 1000)
s10 <- ScaleData(s10)
s10 <- RunPCA(s10)
s10 <- RunUMAP(s10, dims = 1:10)

tmp <- FindMarkers(s10, ident.1 = "CTCL", ident.2 = "T_Cells", group.by = "celltype.malig")
tmp$dif <- tmp$pct.1 - tmp$pct.2

DimPlot(s10, group.by = "cloneSize", cols = clone_colors)
FeaturePlot(s10, features = "TRDC")
FeaturePlot(s10, features = "TRDV1")
FeaturePlot(s10, features = "TRGV2")
FeaturePlot(s10, features = "IL32")

p1 <- DimPlot(s10, group.by = "cloneSize", reduction = "umap", cols = clone_colors)
p2 <- FeaturePlot(s10, features = "TRDV1", reduction = "umap")
p3 <- FeaturePlot(s10, features = "TRGV2", reduction = "umap")
p4 <- FeaturePlot(s10, features = "TOX", reduction = "umap")
p5 <- FeaturePlot(s10, features = "CD7", reduction = "umap")
p6 <- FeaturePlot(s10, features = "S100A6", reduction = "umap")

combined_row <- (p1 + p2 + p3 + p4 + p5 + p6) +
  plot_layout(nrow = 1) &
  theme_void() &
  NoLegend() &
  theme(plot.title = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(0, 16, 0, 16))
combined_row
ggsave("figs/s10_plots.png", plot = combined_row, height = 4, width = 28)
```
